member.name: T:Contract.Compiler.ImportResolver
member.summary:
Python-style import resolution. An import statement names either a quoted file path (import "terminal.ct";) or a dotted namespace (import ovh.finite.hello.Terminal;). Both resolve to a file on disk:
The quoted path resolves relative to the importing file's directory.
The dotted name maps dots to directory separators, like Python modules: ovh.finite.hello.Terminal → ovh/finite/hello/Terminal.ct.
Search roots, in order: the importing file's directory, then the main file's directory, then the current working directory.

member.summary: Maps a dotted namespace to a file path: dots become directory separators and the last segment becomes the file name. Tries source (.ct) then compiled-reference (.oir/.oil/.orbt) extensions. Returns null when no candidate file exists.

member.name: M:Contract.Compiler.Semantics.SemanticAnalyzer.ValidateNativeImports(Contract.Compiler.AST.Program)
member.summary:
Validates <NativeBinding("Module")> contracts: a native binding is a pure facade — no fields, no constructors, and every member function is an empty-bodied declaration that dispatches to Module.Method at runtime. The module must be a registered host binding and each declared method must exist on it.
Also validates the two CLR-facing facades: <ClrImport("System.Math")> (methods map to public static methods on a CLR type, resolved by reflection — no host binding class needed) and <DllImport("user32.dll")> (methods P/Invoke native exports of the named library).

member.name: T:Contract.Compiler.StandardLibrary.StdlibCatalog
member.summary: Registers the ObjektRT.Stdlib modules into a . The stdlib project itself is free of Contract-specific attributes — this catalog is the Contract-side mapping from language module names to CLR types. Each module is registered under its fully-qualified dotted name (so ObjektRT.Stdlib.System.IO.Println and import ObjektRT.Stdlib.System; short forms resolve) and under its short name (so IO.Println works without an import). Hosts register the same types with the runtime's generic RegisterClrType.

member.name: T:Contract.Compiler.TypeNameResolver
member.summary:
Resolves written type names to their fully-qualified wire names, the way Java/C#/Python namespaces work: namespace imports map a short name (or the first segment of a dotted name) onto a full namespace.
Short name Foo:
The current contract's own namespace (com.example.Foo).
Each namespace import as a prefix (import com.lib; → com.lib.Foo).
A unique short-name match anywhere in the program.
Dotted name Terminal.Terminal:
Already-qualified names pass through when registered.
The first segment is mapped through a namespace import (import ovh.finite.hello.Terminal; → ovh.finite.hello.Terminal.Terminal).
The whole dotted name is prefixed with each namespace import (import com.lib; + Direction.North → com.lib.Direction.North).
